name: ECON 2491
title: Internship Research Paper
description: Research paper of 3,000-4,000 words on approved topic related to the internship field study.
requirement_description: Nine credits of 2000 level or above ECON (six of which may be taken concurrently). Students must be 6th semester and have a min CGPA of 2.25 or a min of 2.5 in 2000 level or above economics courses.
